high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a bathroom or dressing area. The individual is wearing a white, knitted halter-neck dress with a unique cut-out design at the front. They have long, dark hair that falls over their shoulders. The person is holding a smartphone with a floral-patterned case in their right hand and a small, beige handbag with a brown strap in their left hand. The setting includes a large, rectangular mirror with a gold frame, reflecting part of the room behind it.
